faqs.registerQ: How to create an ADMA account?
faqs.registerA: Download the app, enter your Cameroon phone number (+237). You will receive an SMS OTP code. Enter it to sign in without any password.
faqs.providerA: Sign in, go to the Profile tab, tap 'Create profile' and fill in your specialty and contact details. Your card will be immediately visible.
faqs.verificationA: Submit a photo of your national ID from the 'Verification' section. Our team reviews your documents within 48h to grant your badge.
faqs.subscriptionA: ADMA offers 4 plans: Free, Premium, Professional and Enterprise, offering increased visibility and radius.
faqs.paymentQ: How to pay for a plan?
faqs.paymentA: From the Subscription screen, pick your plan, then pay securely using Orange Money or MTN Mobile Money with KPay.
faqs.notificationsQ: Why am I not receiving notifications?
faqs.notificationsA: Ensure notifications are enabled in your phone system settings and under 'Settings > Notifications' inside the app.

legal.title: Terms & Privacy
legal.subtitle: Legal information, data protection and ADMA commitments
legal.heroSub: ADMA is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your data transparently.
legal.footer:
By using ADMA, you accept these terms.
Last updated: September 2026
legal.dataText: ADMA only collects information necessary to connect clients and service providers: contact details, profile photos and account identifiers. All data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and never sold to third parties.
legal.usageText: The app is strictly intended for legal and responsible use. Publishing illegal content, threats, spam or misleading information is strictly forbidden.
legal.responsibilityText: ADMA acts as a technical connection platform. We are not party to individual contracts between clients and providers, and disclaim direct liability for disputes.
legal.intellectualText: All app content (logos, text, icons, graphics) is the exclusive property of ADMA. Unauthorized copying is prohibited.
legal.cniText: ID documents submitted for verification are encrypted, securely stored, and deleted within 24 hours of approval or rejection.
legal.rightsText: In accordance with data protection regulations, you have the right to access, rectify and delete your personal data at any time.
